crossRefs.note: Amaziah took courage, and led his people out, and went to the Valley of Salt, and struck ten thousand of the children…
The children of Judah carried away ten thousand alive, and brought them to the top of the rock, and threw them down…
“ ‘If you in spite of these things will not listen to me, then I will chastise you seven times more for your sins.
For the violence done to your brother Jacob, shame will cover you, and you will be cut off forever.
Don’t enter into the gate of my people in the day of their calamity. Don’t look down on their affliction in the day of…
Don’t stand in the crossroads to cut off those of his who escape. Don’t deliver up those of his who remain in the day…

people.name: Edom
people.line: Descendants of Esau; enemy nation southeast of Israel

translations.web: For again the Edomites had come and struck Judah, and carried away captives.
translations.bsb: The Edomites had again come and attacked Judah and carried away captives.
translations.kjv: For again the Edomites had come and smitten Judah, and carried away captives.
translations.asv: For again the Edomites had come and smitten Judah, and carried away captives.
